measurement: Incoming feedstock composition
sampling_location: Each received feed batch before treatment
units: kg wet; % wet mass; % dry matter; kg/t dry matter; mg/kg
method_or_instrument: Use validated gravimetric and accredited laboratory methods; record method and basis
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Harvest or delivery date; location; storage history; sample ID; wet and dry mass
how_to_obtain: Collect representative batch samples and paired weighbridge or calibrated scale data
model_or_decision_use: Sets feed basis and component inputs for all downstream balances

measurement: Particle size and physical feed properties
sampling_location: Before and after size reduction
units: mm distribution; kg/m3; % moisture; contaminant mass fraction
method_or_instrument: Use documented sieve or image method and calibrated density or mass-volume measurement
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Sample point; equipment setting; sample mass; replicate identifier
how_to_obtain: Measure before and after the selected equipment using the same documented method
model_or_decision_use: Supports equipment selection; particle-dependent separation and press performance

measurement: Paired stream mass and component flows
sampling_location: Feed; juice; cake; centrate; recycle and wash streams
units: kg/batch or kg/h; % dry matter; kg/h protein carbohydrate ash; g/h COD; g/h N P K
method_or_instrument: Calibrated flow or mass measurement plus matched laboratory assays
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Simultaneous timestamps; stream IDs; wet basis; dry basis; operating state; unmeasured streams
how_to_obtain: Sample all inlet and outlet streams over a matched operating interval and reconcile measured quantities
model_or_decision_use: Closes Phase 3 mass and component balances and supplies protein and digestion feeds

measurement: Equipment operating conditions and specific energy
sampling_location: At each selected unit inlet outlet and electricity meter
units: kg/h; bar; rpm; mm; g-force; kWh; kWh/t wet; kWh/t dry
method_or_instrument: Calibrated electricity meter and recorded equipment instrumentation
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Throughput; settings; start-stop time; idle time; feed temperature; cleaning events
how_to_obtain: Log synchronized meter readings and operating settings during the paired stream balance
model_or_decision_use: Calibrates unit energy and hydraulic or mechanical performance

technology_options: Dilution washing and conditioning when selected
measurement: Added water and process chemical demand
sampling_location: At each addition point and recovered liquid outlet
units: kg/batch; L/h; kg reagent/t wet feed; concentration; pH
method_or_instrument: Calibrated flow or mass measurement and recorded reagent concentration
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Water or reagent identity; source; concentration; time; recycle fraction; temperature
how_to_obtain: Meter additions and returned or discharged liquid over the same balance interval
model_or_decision_use: Prevents hidden dilution and chemical demand in balances and costs

measurement: Incoming feed proximate and structural composition
sampling_location: Representative whole-grass composite before size reduction washing or storage
units: % wet mass; % dry matter; g/kg DM; kg/t wet feed
method_or_instrument: Validated gravimetric dry matter and ash/volatile-solids methods; crude protein and ether extract; water-soluble carbohydrates and starch; documented NDF/ADF/ADL and structural-carbohydrate assay
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Harvest batch; sample date and site; species or botanical mix; maturity; collection equipment; storage history; replicate; method version
how_to_obtain: Collect paired representative samples for each harvest/delivery batch and report each analyte on both wet and dry bases; retain original lab report
model_or_decision_use: Replaces legacy unmeasured mass allocations only where the analyte and analytical basis match; supports wet/dry mass closure
status: Open; VARTA has GreenHub-batch dry matter and total elements only. Della Rosa 2022 and other ryegrass studies provide B literature comparator assays but are cultivated forage from different samples and cannot replace this batch panel.
owner_role: Feedstock lead plus accredited analytical laboratory

measurement: Incoming protein amount and protein-form split
sampling_location: Whole grass at receipt and matched sample after storage before pressing
units: g/kg DM; g/kg wet feed; % total nitrogen; fraction of total protein
method_or_instrument: Report total nitrogen and crude protein separately; use validated true-protein/non-protein-N and soluble/insoluble fractionation; amino-acid hydrolysis profile must be reported separately from free amino acids
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Matched sample IDs; storage days and temperature; sample preservation; extraction buffer; pH; fraction definitions; replicate and detection limits
how_to_obtain: Take paired aliquots from each batch; use validated Kjeldahl or Dumas with a declared conversion factor and an explicit fractionation protocol; do not infer free amino acids from hydrolysed amino-acid profiles
model_or_decision_use: Separates total protein from soluble protein peptides and free amino acids without double-counting; informs press recovery and product quality
status: Open; UI proxy split is class C 22.8/77.2 from Hoekstra ryegrass nitrogen fractions transferred to Smit roadside-grass total protein. It is not a batch protein-form assay. VARTA crude protein is blank. Varriale 2024 is filtered press-juice only.

measurement: Nitrogen phosphorus and potassium speciation in incoming grass
sampling_location: Whole grass at receipt and matched juice cake and wash streams
units: g/kg DM; mg/kg wet feed; mg/L liquid; species-specific method and detection limit
method_or_instrument: Total digestion plus ICP-OES or validated elemental method for totals; ion chromatography or validated selective assays for dissolved ions; report ammonium nitrate organic/particulate nitrogen and dissolved/particulate phosphorus separately
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Matched sample IDs; wet/dry basis; extraction method; filtration cut-off; preservation; storage history; replicate and detection limits
how_to_obtain: VARTA total N P K and other element measurements remain totals; obtain species-specific assays from the same batch before assigning molecular pools
model_or_decision_use: Constrains NPK mass balances and prevents total elements being silently treated as ammonium phosphate or dissolved ions
status: Open; VARTA reports whole-grass totals while Varriale 2024 reports filtered-juice ion concentrations; neither establishes raw GreenHub species fractions

technology_options: Mechanical cleaning and all selected routes
measurement: Foreign material and contaminant panel
sampling_location: Synchronized incoming feed cleaned feed and retained removed fraction
units: soil/sand/litter: kg/t wet feed; metals/pesticides/PFAS: analyte-specific mg/kg DM or micrograms/kg DM; microplastics: particles/kg DM with size and polymer; pathogen indicators: CFU/g or method-specific count; detection limit per analyte
method_or_instrument: Weigh soil sand and litter gravimetrically; use validated analyte-specific methods for metals pesticides and PFAS; report microplastics as particle counts/kg dry matter with size/polymer identity unless a validated mass method is used; report pathogen indicators in method-appropriate count units; record blanks spikes recovery and analyte-specific detection limits
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Sample ID; location; roadside source; collection equipment; cleaning settings; method/version; replicate; wet/dry basis; size range; polymer; recovery; detection limit
how_to_obtain: Take paired composite samples before and after cleaning and retain removed material for contaminant mass balance; do not convert pathogen counts or microplastic particle counts into mass fractions without validated conversion
model_or_decision_use: Replaces unsupported zero placeholders only for contaminants actually tested and supports feed safety digestate quality and cleaning-loss accounting
status: Open; no matched GreenHub contaminant panel identified
owner_role: Feedstock lead plus accredited analytical laboratory

measurement: Water-soluble organic acids and individual sugars
sampling_location: Same incoming-grass composite used for P3-06; paired juice and cake only when species-level fractionation is reported
units: g/kg DM; mg/kg wet feed; mg/L extract; analyte-specific detection and quantification limits; extraction ratio
method_or_instrument: Use validated aqueous extraction with extraction blanks and spike/recovery checks; quantify individual organic acids and sugars by validated HPLC or ion-chromatography methods with analyte-specific standards; report acetic lactic propionic butyric formic succinic citric malic and oxalic acids plus glucose fructose sucrose xylose arabinose galactose mannose and maltose separately
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Sample ID; wet/dry basis; extraction mass and volume; storage/preservation; method/version; calibration range; replicate; recovery; detection/quantification limit
how_to_obtain: Split the batch composite before storage; preserve and analyze using the laboratory's validated method; do not infer individual compounds from aggregate water-soluble carbohydrates or fiber totals
model_or_decision_use: Replaces unsupported zero placeholders only for analytes actually quantified; prevents aggregate sugar and fiber assays from being double-counted as specific model compounds
status: Open; no matched GreenHub species-level raw-grass panel. Varriale 2024 reports glucose/fructose in separately filtered ryegrass press-juice; it is not raw feed or a matched GreenHub press balance.

technology_options: PR1 acid precipitation PR2 thermal coagulation PR3 combined route; alternatives only if selected
measurement: Protein juice and fraction composition
sampling_location: Protein recovery feed and all liquid and solid outlets
units: g/L soluble protein; g/L insoluble protein; % dry matter; mg/L COD N P K; pH; conductivity; alkalinity
method_or_instrument: Use validated protein fractionation and accredited chemistry methods; report assay protocol
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Stream flow; temperature; sample time; separation method; sample preservation
how_to_obtain: Collect synchronized samples before and after the selected recovery unit
model_or_decision_use: Defines recoverable protein and captures nutrient and COD transfer

technology_options: Acid base heat or other selected extraction route
measurement: Titration response and operating setpoints
sampling_location: Protein recovery feed during treatment
units: mmol H+ or OH-/L; kg reagent/t feed; pH; C; min; kWh/batch
method_or_instrument: Use titration curve and calibrated pH and temperature instruments; record reagent strength
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Starting and final pH; dose; temperature profile; mixing; hold time; feed composition
how_to_obtain: Measure reagent addition and pH or temperature response across each run
model_or_decision_use: Provides defensible reagent and heat requirements rather than fixed dose assumptions

technology_options: Selected precipitation separation or concentration route
measurement: Protein recovery and loss by outlet
sampling_location: Feed juice; concentrate or precipitate; supernatant; wash and reject streams
units: kg/batch; % protein; kg protein/batch; % recovery with explicit denominator
method_or_instrument: Matched flow or mass measurement and protein assay on every stream
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Feed protein; outlet protein; wet mass; dry matter; assay uncertainty; recovery definition
how_to_obtain: Perform a closed stream balance for each operating run and calculate the same source-defined recovery ratio
model_or_decision_use: Calibrates route recovery and ensures protein losses are visible

measurement: Recovered product composition and grade
sampling_location: Final protein concentrate or dried protein product
units: % protein dry basis; % moisture; % ash; g/kg contaminants; product-specific quality units
method_or_instrument: Use accredited assays matched to intended market specification; record standard version
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Product batch; sampling time; moisture basis; assay and uncertainty; destination grade
how_to_obtain: Retain sealed product samples and request full product composition analysis
model_or_decision_use: Determines saleability and valid protein price or substitution value

measurement: Membrane flux fouling rejection and cleaning response
sampling_location: Membrane feed retentate permeate and cleaning loop
units: L/m2/h; % rejection; kWh/m3; bar; C; cleaning chemical kg/m2
method_or_instrument: Use calibrated pressure flow and electricity readings plus feed and outlet assays
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Membrane area; membrane type; run time; flux trend; transmembrane pressure; clean events
how_to_obtain: Collect time series through a complete operating and cleaning cycle
model_or_decision_use: Sets membrane area utility demand and concentration performance
status: Open only if membrane technology selected

measurement: Water removal and dryer energy by product batch
sampling_location: Dryer inlet and outlet plus condensate or exhaust where measurable
units: kg water removed; % inlet outlet moisture; kWh/kg water; kWh/kg product; C; kg/h
method_or_instrument: Calibrated mass and utility meters; document dryer test and exhaust measurement method
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Inlet wet mass; inlet and outlet moisture; product temperature; cycle time; heat and electricity
how_to_obtain: Measure energy and material flows over matched dryer batches and retain product assays
model_or_decision_use: Calculates drying duty emissions cost and final product quality
status: Open only if drying technology selected

technology_options: AD1 post-protein AD AD2 direct AD or AD3 thermophilic route
measurement: Residual-specific biomethane potential and biodegradability
sampling_location: Actual routed digestion feed after upstream processing
units: mL CH4/g VS; mL CH4/g COD; % VS; % COD; test temperature C; test duration d
method_or_instrument: Documented BMP protocol with blanks controls inoculum source and gas normalization
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Substrate ID; VS and COD basis; inoculum; temperature; duration; replicate IDs; uncertainty
how_to_obtain: Run BMP tests on each relevant residual and feedstock batch using the routed material
model_or_decision_use: Separates GreenHub-specific potential from grass-only literature comparators

measurement: Reactor performance and operating state
sampling_location: Reactor feed; reactor; digestate outlet
units: kg/d; m3; d HRT; kg VS/m3/d OLR; C; pH; alkalinity; mixing rate
method_or_instrument: Calibrated flow and temperature instrumentation plus documented daily operating log
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Reactor volume; feed composition; flow; loading; retention time; interruptions; adaptation period
how_to_obtain: Operate and log a representative continuous period after recording start-up and steady state separately
model_or_decision_use: Converts BMP evidence into supported continuous performance and scale requirements

measurement: Gas production and composition
sampling_location: Digester gas outlet before upgrading
units: Nm3/d; % v/v CH4 CO2 H2S N2 O2; normalized conditions; ppm contaminants
method_or_instrument: Calibrated gas meter and gas analyzer; report dry or wet basis and reference conditions
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Gas flow; composition; pressure; temperature; analyzer calibration; downtime
how_to_obtain: Measure gas flow and composition on matching digester operating days
model_or_decision_use: Calculates methane yield and supplies the upgrader inlet state

measurement: Digester feed digestate and gas balance
sampling_location: Feed; digestate; condensate; gas; separated solids and liquor
units: kg/d; % dry matter; kg/d VS COD N P K; g/L ammonium; gas carbon flow
method_or_instrument: Matched mass flow and laboratory assays using stated wet or dry basis
record_with_each_sample_or_run: All inlets and outlets; recycle; sampling interval; uncertainty; unmeasured or fugitive flows
how_to_obtain: Collect paired measurements over the same representative operating period
model_or_decision_use: Closes material nutrient and carbon balances around digestion

measurement: Digester heat and electricity demand
sampling_location: Digester and its heat supply and recirculation systems
units: kWh/d; kWh/t feed; kWh/t VS; inlet and ambient C; heat loss W/K if measured
method_or_instrument: Separate calibrated thermal and electrical metering; document calculation if direct heat measurement is unavailable
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Feed temperature; reactor temperature; external temperature; insulation; recirculation; schedule
how_to_obtain: Measure heat input and electricity over matching digester periods
model_or_decision_use: Improves net energy and seasonal heating calculations without conflating ambient and process temperature

measurement: Raw gas inlet composition and condition
sampling_location: Immediately before upgrading after any conditioning
units: % v/v CH4 CO2 H2S N2 O2; Nm3/h; bar; C; water content
method_or_instrument: Calibrated gas analyzer and meter with declared wet dry and reference basis
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Feed gas variability; pressure; temperature; flow; conditioning state; analyzer calibration
how_to_obtain: Sample synchronously with product gas and offgas for each test interval
model_or_decision_use: Establishes inlet quality and route-specific separation duty

measurement: Product gas and offgas flows and composition
sampling_location: Upgrader product outlet and reject or exhaust outlet
units: Nm3/h; % v/v CH4 CO2 H2S N2 O2; ppm contaminants; reference conditions
method_or_instrument: Calibrated meters and gas analyzers; report detection limits and gas basis
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Simultaneous inlet product offgas; operating settings; sampling time; calibration
how_to_obtain: Measure all outlets in the same stable interval as raw gas
model_or_decision_use: Closes upgrader component balance and checks product specification

measurement: Methane recovery slip and leakage
sampling_location: Methane entering product offgas and any measured fugitive points
units: % recovery; kg CH4/h; % of inlet CH4; ppm or kg/year leakage
method_or_instrument: Calculate recovery only from matched measured inlet and outlet gas flows and compositions; use leak survey method for fugitive points
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Declared denominator; gas basis; time interval; offgas and vent flow; detection limit
how_to_obtain: Reconcile methane across inlet product offgas and measured fugitive points
model_or_decision_use: Separates process CO2 emissions from methane losses and avoids assuming slip
owner_role: Upgrading operator plus independent leak survey

measurement: Upgrader utility and consumable demand
sampling_location: Upgrader and gas conditioning equipment
units: kWh/Nm3 raw gas; kWh/Nm3 product; kg chemical/Nm3; L water/Nm3; replacement interval
method_or_instrument: Submeter electricity heat water and consumables; record equipment operating hours
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Throughput; pressure; feed composition; product quality; regeneration or cleaning cycles
how_to_obtain: Collect meter and inventory records over the same gas balance interval
model_or_decision_use: Supports net biomethane output cost and climate inventory

measurement: Flow-weighted digestate and liquor nutrient speciation
sampling_location: Digestate before recovery and each separated liquid or solid stream
units: kg/d; % dry matter; g/kg total N P K; g/L ammonium phosphate potassium; pH; alkalinity; conductivity
method_or_instrument: Accredited laboratory speciation and calibrated flow or mass measurement
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Sample time; flow; wet or dry basis; sample preservation; analytical method; uncertainty
how_to_obtain: Collect flow-proportional composites where the stream and laboratory method permit
model_or_decision_use: Defines nutrient inventory available to each recovery technology

measurement: Nutrient and solids partition across separator
sampling_location: Separator feed cake centrate filtrate and recycle
units: kg/batch or kg/h; % dry matter; kg/h N P K; kg/h VS COD
method_or_instrument: Matched flow or mass measurement and assays of every outlet
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Equipment type; screen or centrifuge setting; flow; solids; sampling interval
how_to_obtain: Measure paired inlet and outlet streams during stable operation
model_or_decision_use: Provides correct nutrient allocation to downstream recovery and fertilizer products

technology_options: Struvite or calcium-phosphate precipitation only when selected
measurement: Precipitation conditions reagent use recovery and product assay
sampling_location: Reaction feed; reagent additions; recovered crystals; mother liquor
units: mol/mol Mg:P; kg reagent/t feed; pH; C; min; % P recovery; % product purity
method_or_instrument: Record calibrated pH temperature reagent dose and matched P assay; document crystal assay method
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Feed speciation; Mg or Ca source and concentration; mixing; time; wash; crystal mass
how_to_obtain: Run batch or continuous tests at declared dose and recovery conditions
model_or_decision_use: Calibrates nutrient recovery and distinguishes recovered crystals from fertilizer-grade product
status: Open only if precipitation technology selected

technology_options: Ammonia stripping and capture only when selected
measurement: Ammonia transfer and captured ammonium product quality
sampling_location: Stripper feed; gas; scrubber liquor; residual digestate
units: NH4-N g/L; pH; C; air or steam rate; kg reagent; % N recovery; product concentration
method_or_instrument: Calibrated flow temperature and pH measurement plus nitrogen analysis of feed product and residual
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Feed alkalinity; gas flow; acid concentration; temperature; run time; residual N
how_to_obtain: Close nitrogen balance over a complete stripping and capture run
model_or_decision_use: Determines ammonium product yield chemical energy demand and remaining N
status: Open only if ammonia recovery technology selected

technology_options: Nutrient concentration ion exchange or water recovery when selected
measurement: Potassium capture and recovered-water quality
sampling_location: Process feed; concentrate; recovered water; regeneration or reject stream
units: kg/h K; g/L K; L water/h; kWh/m3; kg reagent/m3; conductivity; mg/L COD
method_or_instrument: Nutrient and water assays with calibrated flow and utility meters
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Technology type; loading; pH; cycles; regeneration; final water end use
how_to_obtain: Track all product reject and regeneration outlets through complete cycles
model_or_decision_use: Checks nutrient recovery water reuse and reject liabilities
status: Open only if concentration or ion-exchange technology selected

measurement: Product safety grade and substitution evidence
sampling_location: Final recovered solids liquids or salts and intended application site
units: Product-specific nutrient grade; mg/kg metals; pathogen indicator units; kg product/ha; yield response where tested
method_or_instrument: Use applicable accredited product assays and a documented agronomic field protocol
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Product lot; soil and crop; application rate; comparator fertilizer; site; harvest; relevant legal grade
how_to_obtain: Analyze product and conduct controlled field comparison before claiming substitution
model_or_decision_use: Supports product value environmental credits and safe-use boundary
status: Open matched GreenHub product and field evidence
owner_role: Product lead plus analytical laboratory and agronomist

measurement: Traceable sample and process-run record
sampling_location: At every measurement point
units: ISO or lab sample ID; timestamp; operator ID; calibrated instrument ID; SOP ID
method_or_instrument: Project-approved sample handling and chain-of-custody procedure
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Sample source; preservation; split samples; calibration; deviation; detection limit; method version
how_to_obtain: Use the same sample ID across laboratory result and process log
model_or_decision_use: Links material measurements to the correct unit and time period
owner_role: Project data steward and process lead

measurement: Time-aligned operating schedule and downtime
sampling_location: All process units and utility meters
units: UTC or local timestamp; h; kg/h; kWh; operating state
method_or_instrument: Shared clock and standard operating event log
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Start stop idle cleaning outage feed changes; clock zone; data frequency
how_to_obtain: Log synchronized unit and meter data on one documented time grid
model_or_decision_use: Supports seasonal capacity residence-time utility and annualization calculations
owner_role: Project data steward and process lead

measurement: Measurement uncertainty and mass-balance discrepancy
sampling_location: Each matched unit and whole process
units: Instrument accuracy; lab uncertainty; kg/h; % closure; method-specific reporting
method_or_instrument: Use instrument calibration certificates and laboratory uncertainty reporting; never force closure
record_with_each_sample_or_run: Measured versus derived status; missing stream; detection limit; uncertainty statistic
how_to_obtain: Report independently measured inputs and outputs before calculating closure error
model_or_decision_use: Makes uncertainty and balance gaps visible instead of silently imputing values
owner_role: Project data steward plus process and laboratory leads
